user.description: Pair Home Assistant with a Leassh server (server mode). The token is minted on the server in `fleet.yaml` under `api.tokens` (scope `ha`).

reauth_confirm.description: The Leassh server rejected the stored token. Enter a fresh token minted for the `ha` scope.

reconfigure.description: Change the Leassh server URL or token. The config entry is kept.

error.license_invalid: Leassh server rejected the license. Update the license key in the add-on or fleet.yaml, then reload.

abort.already_configured: This Leassh server is already configured
abort.no_api: The discovered server is not offering the API

data.notify_targets: Companion-app notify targets (comma-separated notify service names, e.g. mobile_app_iphone; empty = all mobile_app targets)

init.title: Repair Leassh license
init.description: Choose **Update license** to fix `license_token`/`license_key`, or **Upgrade** at {upgrade_url}.

update_license.title: Update the license key
update_license.description: In Home Assistant: Settings → Add-ons → Leassh → Configuration → `license_token`. In a manual server: `license_key` in `fleet.yaml`. Restart Leassh, then submit to re-check. Free keys start with LSH-; offline paid tokens start with LSH1.

upgrade.title: Upgrade
upgrade.description: Open {upgrade_url} in a browser, then update the license key.

init.title: Repair Leassh license
init.description: Renew at {account_url} or upgrade at {upgrade_url}. The license expires in {days} day(s).

renew.title: Renew
renew.description: Open {account_url}, enter your pairing code, and use Manage billing. Then submit to re-check.

retry.title: Re-running
retry.description: Re-running the pack pipeline and refreshing state.

disable_pack.title: Disabling pack
disable_pack.description: The pack will not be selected until it is re-enabled or the server restarts.

retry.title: Re-running
retry.description: Re-running the pack pipeline and refreshing state.

disable_pack.title: Disabling pack
disable_pack.description: The pack will not be selected until it is re-enabled or the server restarts.

init.title: Leassh node limit reached
init.description: This {tier} license allows {max} nodes and the fleet has {current}. Existing nodes keep reporting; new nodes are blocked. Remove a node or upgrade at {upgrade_url}.

remove_node.title: Remove a node
remove_node.description: Remove a computer from the add-on nodes list or `fleet.yaml`, restart Leassh, then submit to re-check.
